<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/user"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds the user with useradd, with its home directory, and sets its password with chpasswd when one is given. The controller hashes the password, so the job and NATS have only the hash. A user that the host has already does not change and reports changed: false. When chpasswd fails, the user is removed again with userdel -r, so a second run adds it with its password. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped.
